details.text: The SNOMED CT code 68566005 ('Urinary tract infectious disease') is a disorder, but the observation has a result as its value: the code of an observation with a result says what was observed (an observable entity, or an evaluation procedure), and a finding goes in the value, or in a Condition. A finding can be the code when there is no value, or the value says whether it is present (a boolean, or a yes/no code)
